question: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.6666666666666666
details.actual_sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth GROUP BY SUBSTRING(date, 1, 4) ORDER BY total_consumption DESC LIMIT 1;
details.gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(T2.date FROM 1 FOR 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2.date FROM 1 FOR 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.consumption) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
